Enquiry.title: Enquiry
Enquiry.description: A prospective client project enquiry submitted via the Contact page.

name.description: Full name of the person submitting the enquiry.

consent.description: Explicit user consent to be contacted.

status.description: Triage status managed by Triratna Hi-Tech admins.

sourcePath.description: Application route where the enquiry was submitted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the enquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the enquiry was last updated.

CareerApplication.title: CareerApplication
CareerApplication.description: A job or career interest application submitted via the Careers page.

message.description: Applicant background, skills, or portfolio note.

consent.description: Explicit applicant consent for recruitment follow-up.

status.description: Recruitment review status managed by admins.

sourcePath.description: Application route where the application was submitted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the application was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the application was last updated.

NewsletterSubscriber.title: NewsletterSubscriber
NewsletterSubscriber.description: A newsletter email subscription submitted from the site footer.

sourcePath.description: Application route where the user subscribed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was last updated.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized Triratna Hi-Tech team administrator document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/enquiries/{enquiryId}.description: Client project enquiries submitted through the public Contact page. Public create-only with strict validation; read, update, and delete restricted to verified admins.

/career_applications/{applicationId}.description: Candidate applications submitted through the public Careers page. Public create-only with strict validation; read, update, and delete restricted to verified admins.

/newsletter_subscribers/{subscriberId}.description: Newsletter email subscriptions submitted from the Footer. Public create-only with strict validation; read, update, and delete restricted to verified admins.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted admin allowlist records keyed by UID. Only readable by the owning signed-in user or verified admin; writable only by existing verified admins.
